reply_text:
Found three issues worth fixing before merge:

1. **Short previews lose text and always get an ellipsis** — `src/excerpt.js:6–8`
   `excerpt('hello world', 30)` returns `'hello…'`; even an empty string returns `'…'`. This violates the documented unchanged-when-within-limit behavior.
   **Fix:** Return the input unchanged when its length is at most the limit, before finding a cut point.

2. **A word ending exactly at the limit gets dropped** — `src/words.js:2–4`
   `excerpt('one two three', 7)` returns `'one…'` instead of `'one two…'`. The exclusive slice misses the space at index 7. The existing words test actually enshrines this error.
   **Fix:** Include the boundary at `limit` when searching for a space, and update that test.

3. **Neither helper is wired into card previews** — `src/card.js:1–2`
   `card()` still returns the full, trimmed Markdown body. Neither `excerpt()` nor `toPlain()` has a production caller, so merging this branch alone won’t change card previews.
   **Fix:** Wire plain-text conversion and excerpting into the card body path with the intended preview limit; add a card-level test.

All four existing tests pass. No files changed.
